title: Hack Night: Build in 6 Hours
description: Form a team of up to 3, pick a track, and ship something working by midnight. Pizza is on the club.

title: Weekend Web Dev Bootcamp
description: A full day of React from zero to a deployed project. Laptops required, no prior experience needed.

title: Campus Photo Walk: Golden Hour
description: An hour-long walk across campus chasing the best light of the day. Phones are welcome too.

title: Open Mic Night
description: Five minutes, any act: music, poetry, stand-up, monologues. Sign up as a performer or just come to watch.

title: Pitch Night: Semester Finals
description: Eight finalist teams pitch to a panel of alumni founders. The winner gets seed funding for their idea.

title: Inter-Department Cricket Finals
description: CSE vs Mechanical for the department cup. Snacks stall opens at 2:30 PM.

title: Resume Clinic with Alumni
description: Bring a printed resume and get live feedback from alumni working at product companies.

title: Intro to Machine Learning Workshop
description: Hands-on session: train your first model in Python and understand what is happening under the hood.

title: Badminton Doubles League
description: Register as a pair. Round-robin matches followed by a knockout final.

title: Rang Tarang: Annual Cultural Fest
description: A full day of dance, music, food stalls, and competitions across every department.
